description: This file defines abstract base classes for packed quantized parameters and convolution parameters in the PyTorch ATen library, including method signatures for applying quantized linear transformations and related operations.

classes.name: LinearPackedParamsBase
classes.description: An abstract base class representing packed parameters for quantized linear operations, with methods to apply the operation, including variants with and without activation functions.

classes.name: ConvPackedParamsBase
classes.description: A templated abstract base class for packed convolution parameters in Quantized operations, providing interface methods for applying convolution, unpacking parameters, and retrieving convolution configuration details.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Apply the quantized linear or convolution operation to the input tensor, producing a quantized output.

methods.name: apply_relu
methods.description: Apply the quantized linear or convolution operation with ReLU activation to the input tensor.

methods.name: at::Tensor apply_with_input_q_dq_qweight_dq_output_fp32(at::Tensor input,double input_scale,int64_t input_zero_point)
methods.description: Apply the fused quantized linear operation with input quantization, producing float32 output.

methods.name: at::Tensor apply_with_input_q_dq_qweight_dq_relu_output_fp32(at::Tensor input,double input_scale,int64_t input_zero_point)
methods.description: Apply the fused quantized linear operation with input quantization and ReLU, producing float32 output.

methods.name: apply_dynamic
methods.description: Apply the dynamic quantized operation to the input tensor, with optional range reduction.

methods.name: apply_dynamic_relu
methods.description: Apply the dynamic quantized operation with ReLU activation.

methods.name: at::Tensor & apply_out(const at::Tensor &,double,int64_t,at::Tensor & output)
methods.description: Out variant of the apply method, writing output into provided tensor.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Unpack the parameters into tensors, returning a tuple.

methods.name: bias
methods.description: Retrieve the bias tensor if available.

methods.name: void set_bias(std::optional<at::Tensor>)
methods.description: Set or update the bias tensor for the packed parameters.

methods.name: stride
methods.description: Get the stride configuration of the convolution.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Get the number of groups for convolution.

methods.name: transpose
methods.description: Check if the convolution is transposed.
